texto: Unlike «nachdem», the **bevor** (before) conjunction introduces an action that is **posterior** to which describes the main prayer (Nachzeitigkeit).
In daily or working sentences, both sentences usually coincide at the same time:
1. In present for routines and recommendations: **Bevor du nach Hause gehst, schalte bitte das Licht aus**.
2. In the past when it was told: **Bevor er die Firma verließ, hatte er alle Daten gesichert** (before leaving, it had saved all the data).
Remember that «bevor» is subordinate: the conjugated verb is moved to the last position of the subordinate.

filas: Nachdem er gegessen hatte, ging er.
Bevor er ging, hatte er gegessen.

frases.de: Felix, gehst du schon nach Hause?
frases.en: Felix, are you going home yet?

frases.de: Ja, aber bevor ich gehe, drucke ich noch den Bericht aus.
frases.es: Sí, pero antes de irme, imprimo todavía el informe.
frases.en: Yeah, but before I go, I still print the report.

frases.de: Sehr gut. Und hast du den Computer gesperrt?
frases.es: Muy bien. ¿Y has bloqueado el ordenador?
frases.en: All right. And you blocked the computer?

frases.de: Natürlich. Bevor ich das Büro verlasse, schließe ich immer alle Programme.
frases.es: Por supuesto. Antes de salir del despacho, siempre cierro todos los programas.
frases.en: Of course. Before I leave the office, I always close all the programs.

bloques.pregunta: What temporal relationship does the subordinating conjunction «bevor» express?

opciones.texto: The action of the subordinate occurs after that of the main
opciones.explicacion: «Bevor» means «before»; therefore, the action of the bevor clause is later.

opciones.texto: The action of the subordinate occurs simultaneously
The action of the subordinate occurred before that of the main

bloques.pregunta: Where is the conjugated verb placed within a clause introduced by «bevor»?

opciones.texto: En la última posición absoluta de la cláusula subordinada
opciones.explicacion: Like all subordinate conjunctions, «bevor» sends the conjugated verb at the end.
This position corresponds to closed or mandatory questions.

opciones.texto: In second position exactly the same as in a main sentence
opciones.explicacion: Subordinates with «bevor» do not maintain the main order of prayer.

bloques.frase: Bevor Felix nach Hause geht, ___ er den Computer aus.

opciones.explicacion: After the initial subordinate with «bevor», the main prayer begins with the verb («schaltet aus»).
It is the infinitive or plural of wir / sie, not the third person of Felix's singular.
It's the participle, not the conjugated form of the present.

bloques.frase: Bevor er das Büro verließ, ___ er alle Türen geschlossen.

opciones.explicacion: «hatte geschlossen» is Plusquamperfekt for the action that had already been completed before leaving.
It is Perfekt of present, incompatible with the Präteritum «verließ» in past.
Plural form, does not match the singular «er» subject.

bloques.pregunta: What instruction does this sentence give?
bloques.frase: Bevor du die Datei löschst, musst du eine Kopie speichern.

opciones.texto: Before you delete the file, you must save a copy.
opciones.explicacion: «bevor» is before, «löschst» is deleted and «Kopie speichern» is save copy.

opciones.texto: After deleting the file, create a new copy.
opciones.explicacion: «Bevor» indicates that the copy should be made before the deletion, not after.

opciones.texto: As long as you delete the file, you can't copy anything.
opciones.explicacion: The phrase does not indicate simularity («während»), but a precondition.

bloques.frase: Du musst den Vertrag gründlich lesen, ___ du unterschreibst.

opciones.explicacion: «nachdem» would mean «after you sign», which would be absurd to read the contract.

bloques.frase: Bevor ich gehe schließe ich die Tür
bloques.traduccion: Before I leave I close the door
bloques.explicacion: bevor with verb at the end and main with verb in initial position.

intro: The «bevor» (or «ehe») conjunction indicates that the action of the subordinate occurs after that of the main. It is key to giving instructions and warnings.
